integrity_statement: The claim is proved at the general stated quantifiers by direct multiplication and determinantal geometry. The separately supplied finite checker is corroborative only; source-comparison risk and lack of independent audit remain explicit.
limitations: Both rectangular-band factors have at least two elements; the algebra is the ordinary nonunital semigroup algebra.
Commuting varieties are studied with reduced structure; no statement of reducedness of the defining commutator scheme is made.
Finite arithmetic checks cover selected prime fields; the proof covers arbitrary fields and prime powers.
Equivalent priority claims under sandwich-algebra terminology cannot be ruled out by the literature reviewed.
title: Maximal commutative subalgebras and exceptional equidimensional commuting varieties of rectangular-band algebras
